what_happened: Could not take the dispatch's required fresh idle+loaded Gate 8 wall-clock baseline: another session (teammate impl-607) and the main orchestrator were concurrently active throughout this research phase, which is exactly the condition the dispatch's own VERIFY section and measure-gate-costs.sh's own load guard (threshold 2.0) say must not be used as a control (host loadavg sampled 3.16-6.97 during this dispatch). Substituted the existing dated measurement in shell-script-testing.md's Measured Before/After table, explicitly carried-marked, and recommended a follow-up re-measurement in a genuinely idle window.

Found that verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run() already implements a load-aware contention-tagging mechanism (GATE8_CONTENTION_DETECTED: entry loadavg >= 2.0 or .gate-lock acquire wait >= 10% of budget, tagged WARN-FINDING [CONTENTION]) that directly answers research question 4's 'mechanically distinguishable load-induced kill' ask for Gate 8 -- saved research time by identifying the exact pattern to generalize to the other 29 gates rather than designing one from scratch.

Research report's five answers were directly re-derivable against live state; only two carried figures had moved (the description's '30-60s per-gate bounds' is really 24x30s/1x40s/3x180s, and the report's 228,595ms context-budget suite cost is now 30,962ms live). Both corrections are recorded in the plan's Premise Re-Validation table rather than silently carried.

Two live facts absent from both the description and the research report materially shrank the work: dispatch-strand-probe.sh already implements the heartbeat+quiescence strand detector the report proposed building, and run-all.sh already carries a --cost-class free/moderate/slow/unknown selection axis, so slow-suite relocation needs no new selection machinery. This also closed research question 5's blocking open item (the fix builds on background Bash, not an unverified background-Agent capability).

The record's measured-baseline deliverable could not be produced in this plan dispatch either: sibling sessions (impl-607, the orchestrator) were live throughout, the same contamination that blocked the research dispatch. It is carried as Phase 1 with an explicit idle/deferred decision gate rather than taken contaminated.

test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's baseline (--max-cost moderate) case fails standalone mid-implementation because the deployed .claude/ tree has not yet been redeployed from source (per Phase 8), so gate3/gate5/gate27 report source-vs-deployed drift for files this task has already edited in the source store. This is expected per the deploy-root-guard.sh memory note injected into this dispatch -- a source-store invocation does not execute as written pre-deploy -- and resolves at Phase 8's redeploy; Gate 20's own case1-5 assertions (the suite's actual subject) all pass.
